---
title: "Install"
---

Python 3.10 or newer.

```bash
pip install git+https://github.com/HI-IDN/skemman-harvester.git
```

That gives you the `skemman` command:

```bash
skemman --help
```

## From source

```bash
git clone git@github.com:HI-IDN/skemman-harvester.git
cd skemman-harvester
pip install -e ".[dev]"
pytest
```

## As a submodule

If your analysis lives in its own repository and you want to develop both together, vendor
this one in:

```bash
git submodule add git@github.com:HI-IDN/skemman-harvester.git
pip install -e ./skemman-harvester
```

That is how [skemman-msc](https://github.com/HI-IDN/skemman-msc) uses it.

## Configure

Copy `config/collections.yaml` and edit it:

```yaml
{{< include ../config/collections.yaml >}}
```

::: {.callout-important}
## Put a real address in `user_agent`

It is what makes your crawler identifiable to the people running the server. A contactable
crawler gets a conversation when something goes wrong; an anonymous one gets blocked.
:::

`request_delay_seconds` is the pause between requests. `record_limit` can be set to a
number such as `10` for a quick check, or left blank to harvest everything. `titlepage_pages`
controls how many PDF pages are kept as text; leave it blank to keep the whole PDF text.

## Find a collection handle

Browse to a collection on Skemman. The URL ends in the handle:

```
https://skemman.is/handle/1946/2064
                            ^^^^^^^^
```

That is what `--location` takes.
